crossDomainDispositions.disposition: Keep CS: elimination/factorization/root bracketing/stable arithmetic are numerical computation invariants. No model fitting, training objective, gradient-learning-rate lesson or regression interpretation is added.

Keep CS: representation updates, mergeability, bounded counters and sampling-data-structure operations. Probability assumptions and error definitions are explicitly assumed; no polling sample-size lesson is retaught.
Keep CS: factor extraction and segmented/linear/wheel sieve operations. Unique factorization and the basic Eratosthenes square-root argument are prerequisites, not new primary objectives.
Keep CS: weighted/partition-based selection algorithms and search certificates. Statistical robustness or median-voter equilibria are not primary objectives.
Multiplicative weights remains an online expert-loss update with a fixed comparison class; no supervised-model fitting or gradient optimizer is presented.

Full coefficient alignment and invertible transforms remain separate from a fixed image derivative stencil and sampling aliasing. FFT normalization, root order and XOR-index combination are the new invariants.
